children: Northern Trust Asset Management, a leading global investment management firm with $1.6 trillion in assets under management as of June 30, 2026, today announced the launch of two new municipal bond ETFs: the Northern Trust New York Intermediate Tax-Exempt Bond ETF (Nasdaq: TXNY) and the Northern Trust California Intermediate Tax-Exempt Bond ETF (Nasdaq: TXCA).

The ETFs offer exposure to high-quality, intermediate-duration municipal bonds issued in New York and California. Income from each fund is exempt from federal income taxes and from state income taxes in the applicable state. For investors in two of the nation's highest-tax states, tax-exempt income can play an important role in helping preserve more of what a portfolio earns.
TXNY and TXCA provide targeted exposure to intermediate-duration municipal bonds, offering a balance of income potential and interest-rate risk protection in an uncertain rate environment.
“Investors are increasingly seeking precise, tax-aware fixed income solutions that align with where they live and pay taxes,” said
Dave Abner, Global Head of ETFs and Funds at Northern Trust Asset Management

. “For investors in high-tax states such as New York and California, these funds offer access to tax-exempt income that can be an important portfolio consideration. Northern Trust Asset Management brings longtime fixed income leadership to the ETF market, pairing our investment expertise with the efficiency of the ETF structure.”

TXNY and TXCA are managed by Northern Trust Asset Management's municipal bond investment team, which has more than 30 years of experience managing national and state-specific municipal bond portfolios. The team oversees a broad range of municipal bond strategies across active mutual funds, index and laddered ETFs, and active and laddered separately managed accounts.

The launch expands Northern Trust's lineup of tax-exempt ETFs, which also includes TAXT, TAXI and TAXS. Introduced in 2025, those funds have grown to more than $370 million in assets as of August 31, 2026.

With more than 15 years of experience managing ETFs and $27 billion in ETF assets as of June 30, 2026, Northern Trust Asset Management offers a diversified range of active and passive ETFs across equities, fixed income and real assets.
